pages.title: Gorger
pages.text: The Gorger is an immobile creature that uses a sinkhole trap to ambush prey and can be found pretty much everywhere, even in the sparse expanse of the End. The trap is a simple 3x3 hole, around a dozen blocks deep with the Gorger at the bottom. The top is covered by $(l:blocks/mirage_blocks)$(c)$(o)Mirage Blocks$() that look like the surrounding environment but are not solid and can be fallen through.
Gorgers are made up of a maw, $(l:blocks/gorger_guts)$(c)$(o)Gorger Guts$(), and $(l:materials/gluttonous_scales)$(c)$(o)Gluttonous Scaleplates$().
